accounts.subtitle: Ama-akhawunti aphelele athengiswayo, anentengo nge-DHB
accounts.priceHint: ≈ ${{usd}} · kukhokhelwa ngqo umthengisi, i-DeHub ayithathi lutho
accounts.deliverToSelf: Lesi sikhwama. Sisha, ngakho i-akhawunti ingafika khona lapha.
accounts.deliveryExplainer: I-akhawunti ifika esikhwameni esisha, esingakaze sisetshenziswe, esesike sangena ku-DeHub okungenani kanye — lokho kungena kwangaphambilini yikho esikwazi ngakho ukuthi ikheli ngempela ngelakho.
accounts.wrongChain: Shintshela ku-Base noma i-BNB Chain kuzilungiselelo ukuze uthenge i-akhawunti.
accounts.ownListing: Lokhu uhlu lwakho siqu. Lulawule kusuka kuthebhu Thengisa.
accounts.assurance: I-akhawunti ishintsha umnikazi kuphela ngemva kokuba i-DeHub ifundile ukudlulisa kwakho kwe-DHB ku-chain. Uma ukudlulisa kuphazamiseka, inkokhelo yakho ihlala ibhalisiwe kulokho kuthengiswa futhi ukuzama futhi kuyaqhubeka — awusoze wasala ungenalutho.
accounts.signInToSell: Ngena ukuze ubeke i-akhawunti yakho emakethe.
accounts.priceOk: ≈ ${{usd}}. Umthengi ukukhokhela ngqo — i-DeHub ayithathi lutho.
accounts.pitchPlaceholder: Yasungulwa ngo-2021. Abalandeli abangu-4k, umlando ohlanzekile...
accounts.saleFinal: Ukuthengisa kuphelele futhi kuhambisa konke — igama lakho, okuthunyelwe, abalandeli, umlando wamathiphu namalungelo ebheji. Lesi sikhwama bese singena ku-akhawunti entsha, engenalutho.
accounts.walletStays: Isikhwama sakho asithengisi: i-DHB, ibhalansi yebheji efakiwe nezinto eziqoshiwe zihlala nezikhiye zakho.
accounts.resumeBody: Inkokhelo yakho iphumelele kodwa ukudlulisa akuqedanga. Qhubeka nakho — akukho okulahlekile.
